findings.title: Fallback list not cached and depends on SiteSetting at call time
findings.body: `FallbackLocaleList#[]` reads `SiteSetting.default_locale` on every lookup and builds a new array. It also depends on the DB-backed setting being available at call time. During early boot, in rake tasks, or before the DB is ready, a fallback lookup can raise or return the wrong value. The cost is also paid on every missing-translation lookup.

findings.title: Fallbacks mixed into backend class; load order and cache interplay
findings.body: `I18n.backend.class` is evaluated at initializer time. If the backend is later replaced (for example by a chain or a different class), the Fallbacks module is silently missing. Fallback results also go through the LRU cache keyed only by key and locale, so a change to the site default locale yields stale cached fallback translations.

findings.title: ensure_loaded! check is not thread-safe
findings.body: `@loaded_locales ||= []` and the `include?` check run outside `LOAD_MUTEX`. `reload!` also resets `@loaded_locales` without the lock. Concurrent requests can race, although `load_locale` rechecks inside the lock, so the main risk is a nil or stale array.

findings.title: Fallback locales are loaded on every request
findings.body: `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!` runs in a before_filter for every request. Each call builds arrays and calls `SiteSetting.default_locale`. It also triggers loading the default locale and English translation files on the first request, adding latency. The filter cannot be skipped for requests that never use I18n.
